item.description:

Title: “Control of optical and magnetic properties of 1D carbon materials”

item.title: Congratulations to Artem Abramov!
item.description:
Congratulations to our PhD student Artem Abramov for winning an UMNIK Photonics grant!

In his project, Artem will develop a technology for fabricating single photon emitters based on two-dimensional semiconductors integrated with nanophotonic structures: https://umnik.fasie.ru/photonica

item.title: Congratulations to Tatiana Ivanova!
item.description:
Congratulations to our MSc student Tatiana Ivanova for receiving the bronze sphinx award as the best ITMO student graduating in 2022!

See the corresponding ITMO news entry via the following link: https://news.itmo.ru/ru/university_live/achievements/news/12672/
